value.title: Family Restaurant Meeting With Dad
value.synopsis: The series of incidents involving the former Yozakura heads turn out to part of Momo's plot to resurrect his beloved wife, Rei. As he whispers about his twisted love for his family, Momo vanishes from Mutsumi and the others' sight. Meanwhile, Kyoichiro, who was saved by Taiyo's Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, returns home to his siblings. The touching reunion is short-lived, as in order to make him reflect after trying to sacrifice himself to protect the family, a "Day of Family Service" begins! What lies in store for Kyoichiro is his siblings' merciless requests... Just then, a message arrives for Mutsumi.

value.title: The Gold Rank Spy Meeting
value.synopsis: Under Mutsumi's orders, Kyoichiro and Taiyo pursue the fleeing Momo. Taiyo manages to land a punch on Momo once, but the gap in abilities between himself and Momo, who can hold his own against Kyoichiro, is all too clear, and he's left on the defensive. On top of that, numerous Dark Cherries - creatures birthed by Tsubomi, which feed on humans as nutrients - appear, blocking the way. Taiyo launches another attack, but he falls just short, letting Momo get away. Kyoichiro destroys the Dark Cherries, and is about to take Taiyo back with him to Mutsumi, when he's suddenly summoned by the chairman of the Spy Association, Kai Izumo...
